people_also_viewed.company:
Global Head Portfolio Optimization, member of the Sandoz and Mature Brands Supply Chain, Novartis Technical Operations.

Novartis is the worlds leading Pharmaceutical company that develops innovative products preventing and curing diseases, enhancing people’s quality of life.

Building on past experiences in Functional Management, Divisional and Managing Director roles for both large scale (>1500 fte’s) as start-up companies in Pharma Supply Chain, Business Services and FMCG.

Core of what I do at Novartis is driven by the ambition to succeed, through collaboration, applying global, cross-cultural professional experiences (having worked and lived in the US, UK, Netherlands, Singapore and Switzerland, with management responsibilities across the America’s, Middle East, Africa, and Asia) and, leveraging on a diverse functional background in Marketing, Sales, Finance, General and Strategic Management, Cost and Management Accounting, Supply Chain management, Strategy, M&A, IT, and R&D, along with a formal training in Business Economics (Master) and Engineering (Ing. - Bachelor).

All this is my basis to successfully contribute; lead teams, projects and organizations.

Specialties: Supply Chain, Management Managing Business for growth; from Business Start Ups to Mature Corporate Units □ P&L Management □ Board/Shareholder Interaction □ Risk Management


Marketing & Sales, Operations, Strategy development and implementation, Customer Experience, Lean, Commercial, Pre- and Post Acquisition, General Management, Divestment Implementations.
